entries.subject: DAMIT 1798: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 1798, version 2017-06-19, pole (224°, 58°), period 7.11539 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 133 ± 4 km, volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model. DAMIT marks model 1798 as size-calibrated (D = 133 km, σ = 4 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 132 ± 4 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 13 light curves, 1 adaptive-optics image and 2 occultations (Table 3).
